subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Future of Visual Storytelling
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Future of Visual Storytelling usable.

hook.text: Virtual production, AI, and VR are changing how visual stories are told. The image is evolving.

buildup.text: LED volume stages — used in The Mandalorian — replace green screens with real-time environments.

discovery.text: AI can generate images, but it cannot compose a frame with emotional intention — yet.

twist.text: VR promises fully immersive visual storytelling, but audiences still prefer watching, not wandering.

climax.text: Technology changes. The human need for meaningful visual stories stays the same.

punchline.text: New tools. Same need. Better stories.

quiz.question: What technology did The Mandalorian use instead of green screens?
options: LED volume stages with real-time virtual environments
